notes:
The fake backend is the only backend checked; the sim backend was not run (it needs SUMO_HOME, SUMO, sumolib and traci, and package code never imports the clone). The fake is a pure-Python analytic stand-in for SumoEnvironment, not SUMO: it models no vehicle dynamics, car-following, lane changing, routing, traffic-signal timing or TraCI interaction, and was not compared with the upstream environment. It returns the declared 11-element observation (2 green phases + 1 min-green flag + 2 x 4 lanes), so no smaller array is substituted. The driver configures the single-intersection network of the upstream gym test (tests/gym_test.py:8-14) with num_seconds=100; the env_kwargs paths are relative to the repository root. Accepted warnings from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.index and seed (twice); these are the expected Gymnasium-family warnings (PLAYBOOK.md section 8). There were no G4 warnings. No hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); its evidence is contract_checked. No catalogue_requests: only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. No site-limits.example.json: the driver declares no operator-required bound.
